description: Source code for a firmware image generator tool, including command-line parsing, CRC calculation, and file writing routines.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses command-line arguments, processes files and partitions, and generates the firmware image.

methods.name: find_board
methods.description: Finds a board configuration based on model name.

methods.name: update_crc
methods.description: Updates CRC value with new data.

methods.name: get_crc
methods.description: Calculates CRC for given data buffer.

methods.name: errmsg
methods.description: Prints an error message with optional system error string.

methods.name: dbgmsg
methods.description: Prints debug messages based on verbosity level.

methods.name: process_files
methods.description: Processes and validates input files for firmware blocks.

methods.name: write_out_header
methods.description: Writes firmware header to output file.

methods.name: write_out_blocks
methods.description: Writes block descriptors and data to output file.

methods.name: write_out_padding
methods.description: Writes padding bytes to align data.

methods.name: write_out_file
methods.description: Writes a firmware block's data to output file, including headers if needed.
